limits: No web photos, videos or map artwork copied into runtime assets.
Public entrance maps establish area geography, not measured interior plans.
Model dimensions/depths/headings remain representative; GTFS platform projections do not determine a safe threshold.
Default timing uses selected away-from-Waterfront path intervals symmetrically; runtime curve timing can account for direction-specific adjustments.
